待确认与数据限制

M2 未发起用户确认，当前确认预算使用量为 0。尚无可靠置信区间。

  • Upstream gaps were forward-filled or zeroed; original missingness is not recoverable.
  • IAM spikes above 4000 W were replaced with zero upstream.
  • Issues=1 means the sum of IAM channels exceeds aggregate power.
  • Appliance identities describe monitored channels, not every appliance owned by a household.

有效区间电量不代表完整日账单；使用未来上下文的离线模型不应宣传为实时识别。
